qa_pairs.question: How has the institutional role of the AEO Center evolved to manage the processing of Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) applications compared to the earlier committee-based structure?
qa_pairs.answer: Under the 2018 framework, a committee was responsible for application scrutiny and recommending certification [0]. By 2024-2025, this evolved into a specialized AEO Center model where the Director General of the AEO Center is mandated to form a specialized branch under an Assistant Commissioner of Customs to handle the receipt and initial verification of applications [1], [7]. The Center now also ensures the accessibility of application forms, procedures, and provides guidance to interested applicants [6], while utilizing formal workflows for handling information deficiencies in applications [10].

qa_pairs.question: What are the procedural requirements for an Authorized Economic Operator when submitting applications for specific benefits like duty drawback?
qa_pairs.answer: When an AEO submits an application for duty drawback, they must explicitly mention their certification status and ensure the application is submitted on a pad containing the AEO logo [8]. Furthermore, applicants must have a clear understanding of the provisions set forth in the AEO (Recognition and Management) Rules, 2024, and follow these rules strictly during the application submission and processing stages [5].
